exposure: maternal macro and micronutrient intake at term
cohort: The cohort consisted of 17 healthy mothers with uncomplicated pregnancies and their full-term newborns.
finding: Maternal macro and micronutrient intake at term was not associated with sIgA concentrations in colostrum or neonatal feces, but fecal sIgA was negatively associated with birth weight.
mod_finding: sIgA concentrations in colostrum and neonatal feces were similar regardless of delivery method.
cross-section timing: Maternal intake was assessed at term, and colostrum and neonatal fecal sIgA concentrations were measured shortly after birth during the neonatal period.
birth_weight: Included for analysis (no specific range given).
